""" def generate_event_html(title: str, description: str, date: str, extra_notes: str) -> str: """ Create a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Notes ----- - All user supplied content is escaped using ``html.escape`` to prevent XSS. - The template uses Python's :class:`string.Template` which performs simple placeholder substitution; no arbitrary code execution is possible. - The function guarantees that the resulting HTML contains only expected tags and attributes, mitigating CWE‑707.
